content.comment_body: Good Morning, I am using a [product_name] with [version_no] ([article_no]) and have configured the [product_name] Web Editor, accessing it online via a connected internet cable and web login. After moving the setup to a mobile piece of equipment, I purchased a [product_name] ([product_name] CMR model). I've configured the [product_name] CMR and can successfully ping it; I'm also able to log in to the CMR through my browser. However, I cannot ping the [product_name]'s IP address, nor can I access its web interface via browser. Is there anyone who can advise if a particular step is needed, or if upgrading to another [product_name] CMR model would help improve performance? Could the issue be related to needing a newer [version_no] instead? Thank you, [user_name]

Good Morning Everyone, The issue was resolved by setting the device's default gateway to the same IP address as the [product_name] CMR. If you are using this configuration, ensure your gateway settings match the [product_name] CMR IP.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced connectivity problems while trying to access their [product_name] over VPN using a [product_name] CMR after installation on mobile equipment. Although the CMR was reachable and login worked, access to the device's web interface was blocked due to incorrect network settings. The solution was to configure the device's default gateway to match the [product_name] CMR IP, illustrating a typical networking misconfiguration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects easily accessible and reliable remote connectivity to their [product_name] using VPN, with straightforward setup and consistent performance.
